title: On Releasing Annotator-Level Labels and Information in Datasets
reasoning: The paper's core argument is about the ethical implications of data aggregation practices. It investigates how majority voting can systematically under-represent minority perspectives, leading to representational biases, which is a fundamental ethical issue in AI and data science. The paper analyzes how annotators' socio-demographic factors, lived experiences, and moral values influence subjective annotations. The recommendations provided aim to establish more ethically responsible and transparent dataset creation processes.
